question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4250da936ebaa6434df85e85808f84b62ad53b007173d2e658af7bc08ebec7f6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2, and figure 3 to 4:

Top-left and bottom-right are interchanged and top-right and bottom-left are interchanged.

From figure 2 to 3, and figure 4 to 5:

Shapes are rotating their position in clockwise direction by 90° at the same position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0797c297fa4f099eedbdfcc74ede9529f70d64ec024ffb1da0ec9977b0950b2a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
